verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents one: the docs describe only web-platform workflows, a Gusto integration and Excel exports, and probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
